column3: Request: Text graphics for feed  Due: ASAP Intention: To share our three pillars and guiding principles Slide 1: Craftsmanship - We merge time-honored traditions with modern techniques to create the highest level of quality in every piece. Inspired by classic workmanship and heritage design, our partners take pride in carefully crafting each piece to order, with a special touch that can't be replicated by machines. Slide 2: Responsibility - To minimize our environmental impact, High Light pieces are handmade to order and crafted from certified recycled solid gold, ethically sourced materials, and consciously created lab-cultured diamonds. Slide 3: Purpose - We seek to inspire you to reconnect with yourself, to delight in the natural wonders we so often overlook, to feel gratitude for the gift that is the present–with the belief that these individual actions can lead to a deeper sense of compassion for others.

column3: Slide 1: “At the core of our mission is a commitment to creating pieces that will stir your soul and invite you inward.” - Founder, Donnie Soddu  Slide 2: Dear reader, High Light began as a personal pursuit, a creative outlet, an escape. As a mother and person of color with a deep respect for nature, I felt a strong pull to create something hopeful and environmentally responsible. Slide 3: I decided to channel my experience in the fashion, wellness and beauty industries to create a company that combines timeless design with a sense of intentionality and care for our shared future. Slide 4: To me, High Light is about the practice. The shift in mindset toward the deeper appreciation and compassion that our future requires. Slide 5: The pieces we create are simply manifestations of that mindset, made to help support that shift. I hope they bring you pleasure and peace. — Donnie

column3: Request: Spell bracelet story set  Intention: Introduce spell bracelets To be posted: Sept 6/7Story set needed: YES STORY SET ONLY  Slide 1: Are you a seeker, a weaver, a lover, a starchild?  Slide 2: New in the realm of High Light Rituals, Spell Bracelets are wearable intentions.  Slide 3: Adorn your wrist with The Seeker Spell Bracelet to access cosmic connection and spiritual awakening. Wear it to help you tap into your highest potential and navigate the currents of self-discovery. Labradorite acts as a conduit for higher consciousness. Its energy clears mental clutter to reveal a path to your intuitive wisdom. Moonstone channels the energy of the moon and the divine feminine, facilitating a deeper connection to intuition and inner wisdom. Herkimer Diamond acts as a bridge between your highest self and the cosmic realm. Its clarity and high vibration amplify spiritual awareness and psychic abilities. Clear Quartz, the “Master Healer”, amplifies and protects your spell. Slide 4: Call on The Wealth Weaver Spell Bracelet to invoke financial success and greatness. Wear it during a negotiation or business opportunity to channel the strength and confidence to claim what’s yours. Pyrite will boost your confidence and attract opportunities for financial growth. Citrine, a stone of abundance, radiates positivity and joy while fostering a mindset that attracts opportunities. Green Aventurine, the ""Stone of Opportunity,"" aligns with the heart chakra, bringing about good luck and opening doors to greatness. Clear Quartz, the “Master Healer”, amplifies and protects your spell. Slide 5: Wear the Love Spell Bracelet when you’re ready to accept the kind of love you deserve (you know the kind) and to help clear out any blockages that keep you from receiving love. Or, just wear it as a reminder that self-love might be the most important love there is. Rose Quartz, the “Love Stone” opens your heart to give and receive affection, attracting romantic, platonic, and self-love. Pink Tourmaline deepens compassion and promotes trust and safety in matters of the heart. Rhodochrosite supports emotional healing and self-love, for deeper connections with yourself and others. Clear Quartz, the “Master Healer”, amplifies the love spell while protecting your heart. Slide 6: Reach for The Cosmic Bliss Spell Bracelet to channel your utmost happiness and bliss, or when you feel empowered to tap into your inner joy but need a boost to get there. Wear it to appreciate your many gifts and start navigating your life with positivity. Dalmatian Jasper conjures a playful positivity that encourages that infuses your spirit with vitality. Citrine, the stone of abundance and happiness, radiates warm and uplifting vibrations, helping you attract joy and embrace the sunny side of life. Rose Quartz, the ultimate heart healer, creates a foundation for happiness from within. Clear Quartz, the “Master Healer”, amplifies and protects your spell. Slide 7: (as option) What spell will you cast in this season of your life?

column3: Request:  The Ritualist blog post break down  Intention: Promote the blog and themes  To be posted: October 17Story set needed: Yes - Story and feed Copy:  Slide 1: Five Ways to Connect with Spirit Through Rituals of Adornment  Slide 2:  Perhaps you are already working with jewelry ritually subconsciously, or maybe you are already ritually minded, casting spells with your sacred and favorite pieces. Here are five ways to connect with spirit through rituals of adornment.Slide 3: 1. Wearing Jewelry to Set an Intention  Call on rituals of adornment to help set intentions. To do this, first, cleanse the piece using sacred smoke, salt, or crystals. Then, hold the jewelry in both your hands. Speak your intention over the jewelry three times. Slide 4: 2. Adornment as a Protection Spell Speak a spell of protection over your rings, earrings, necklaces, and bracelets, and feel them absorb any negative energy that comes your way. Use healing smoke to cleanse your pieces, place them in a dish of salt, or allow them to sit in the light of the moon to help clear any energy from your day-to-day. Slide 5: 3. Rituals of Adornment to Ground and Center  Adorning yourself with jewelry intentionally imbued with the healing power of crystals can balance, support and transform your energetic body. When you feel your energy become low, chaotic or detached, simply pause, touch the necklace you’re intentionally wearing, and take a deep breath.  Slide 6: 4. Connecting with the Moon’s Magic through Jewelry  Place your jewelry on a windowsill or inside a bit of silk outside to absorb the glow and energy of the moon. You might feel called to do this on a new moon phase if you wish to enchant your jewelry with the energy of new beginnings or intention setting, or on a full moon if you wish to charge your jewelry with the powers of release, wholeness, or celebration.  Slide 7: 5. Wearing Jewelry as Ancestral Veneration  By wearing jewelry handed down through your family, you honor those who came before you, working with your body as an altar. If you don’t have a relationship with your ancestors, or heirlooms to wear,  you can purchase auspicious pieces of jewelry in the name and honor of a specific family member, or acquire jewelry that is special to you to pass down to the next generation, as you will one day be a benevolent ancestor. column3: Slide One: What is the Shadow Self? & Why Should I Connect with It? Slide Two: Everyone has a Shadow Self. The term was popularized by psychiatrist & psychoanalyst Carl Jung, & refers to an unconscious part of a person that constitutes a blind spot or repressed traits. Perhaps you’re prone to jealousy, reactivity, or judgment. The Shadow is somehow deemed “not ideal” and therefore not integrated with the whole individual, existing just out of sight.   Slide Three: Image Slide Four: Invite your demons to tea.  Slide Five: Their wisdom may surprise you.  Slide Six: Your Shadow Self longs to be accepted & seen. It asks you to get curious about the parts of yourself that you reject, so that you can live a more empowered and authentic life.  Slide Seven: The Shadow offers wisdom and clarity. It celebrates your wholeness.  Slide Eight: Honor &  integrate your Shadow through ritual, journaling, meditation, practicing non-judgment, & working with a professional.  Slide Nine: Your Shadow Self is full of rich wisdom, lessons, and deep self-love.

column3: Before you know what kindness really is you must lose things, feel the future dissolve in a moment like salt in a weakened broth. What you held in your hand, what you counted and carefully saved, all this must go so you know how desolate the landscape can be between the regions of kindness. How you ride and ride thinking the bus will never stop, the passengers eating maize and chicken will stare out the window forever. Before you learn the tender gravity of kindness, you must travel where the Indian in a white poncho lies dead by the side of the road. You must see how this could be you, how he too was someone who journeyed through the night with plans and the simple breath that kept him alive. Before you know kindness as the deepest thing inside, you must know sorrow as the other deepest thing. You must wake up with sorrow. You must speak to it till your voice catches the thread of all sorrows and you see the size of the cloth. Then it is only kindness that makes sense anymore, only kindness that ties your shoes and sends you out into the day to mail letters and     purchase bread, only kindness that raises its head from the crowd of the world to say it is I you have been looking for, and then goes with you every where like a shadow or a friend.

Feet on the earth. If it brings you back, it counts.
